name: GreenSnow blocklist
tier_rationale: Identifiable operator with a public site and several years of public track record (A8 community).

reliability.justification: IPs seen attacking GreenSnow sensors (scans, brute force); noisy.

list.title: GreenSnow attacking IPs (greensnow.txt)

terms.quote: Noncommercial, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: blocklist.de, CINS, ET compromised IPs, GreenSnow and DataPlane (A1 BR16), VoIPBL, and the FireHOL level1 aggregate (it embeds noncommercial upstreams such as DShield).

list.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 2); research C0354 terms 'Free for non-commercial use; attribute source' (verified_live 200; Last-Modified changes on every request: no usable validators). LOW fidelity (P149 cond 6). Used by ip_blocklists.
list.licensed_alternative: The open feeds of ip_blocklists (Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP, abuse.ch Feodo Tracker and SSLBL, IPsum, Binary Defense) keep running; a licence_allow entry recording the operator's written permission enables this feed.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P149). Downloaded whole by the dataset manager (conditional GET, validation) and matched locally: no value is ever sent. Never redistributed outside the team (P149 cond 2).
